title: L10 / G9-C6: John's real SliQ header-mapping template
public_pr_body:
Adds docs/handover/SLIQ-HEADER-MAPPING-TEMPLATE-JOHN.md: sixteen report sections and all 125 existing importer/reconciliation canonical fields, with actual headers, private samples, format/join meaning and Code-review blanks. Includes file/tab/filter/hash identity, absent/empty-report proof, statuses/VAT/sign/discount/date rules, accountant WIP COST, next numbers and practice/final verification gates.

Real headers are deliberately blank. The six comparison-only kinds remain labelled; no automatic jobs/orders/deliveries import or confirmed profile is promised. Filling the form resolves the information gap only after original files/mapping/no-write reconciliation are verified by John/Code and the original importer owner.

Checks: every current canonical/extra key/type/minimum exactly once, sixteen kinds/125 fields, blank headers, gate/whitespace review pass. Handover embedded. No profile flag, importer, actual export, write or runtime proof changed; one independent draft, no main merge, production SQL, deployment or Ready label.
